events.title: Drive reads speed up on first access
events.summary: Vercel announced up to 6× faster cold file reads from mounted Drives, which load data on demand and cache it locally.

events.title: Sandbox API keys gain scoped permissions
events.summary: New API keys can be restricted to one workspace and given separate permissions for sandboxes and snapshots.

events.title: Services arrive in the SDKs and CLI
events.summary: The v0.7.16 release added Services operations to the SDKs and CLI.

events.title: InstaBox adds T4 and A100 machines
events.summary: Paid plans can now run CUDA workloads on NVIDIA T4 and A100 virtual machines with per-second billing while the machine is running.

events.title: Interactive input for sandbox commands
events.summary: Harness Runtime can now send stdin to an active command while stdout and stderr continue streaming, enabling REPLs and interactive prompts. It is enabled per team.

events.title: machine0 exposes skipped image rebuilds
events.summary: A new Last Rebuild status explains skipped Git-tracked rebuilds in the dashboard, CLI, SDK and MCP.

events.title: Rakazo connects to InstaBox computers
events.summary: Self-hosted Rakazo bots can attach InstaBox cloud computers as their sandbox environment.

events.title: InstaBox adds H100 GPU machines
events.summary: The new H100 option is available through the GPU Linux machine flow on paid plans.

events.title: Scheduled sandbox snapshots
events.summary: Buddy added automatic sandbox snapshots on a schedule, with retention policies to manage old copies.

events.title: Python SDK reaches 1.0
events.summary: Vercel stabilized the Python API, added parity with the TypeScript SDK, and documented synchronous and asynchronous modes.

events.title: Access-token CLI and template controls
events.summary: The CLI gained access-token sign-in and project switching. SDKs added listing and deletion for sandbox templates.

events.title: Docker introduces sandbox port commands
events.summary: Version 0.54 adds commands to list, publish and unpublish ports on local and cloud sandboxes, plus networking and cloud-create improvements.

events.title: BrowserPod 4.0 goes free for production
events.summary: Leaning Technologies released BrowserPod 4.0 with expanded networking and built-in programs, and made browser-local use free for commercial production.

events.title: Boat investor discloses $1.43M subscription ARR
events.summary: Investor Orange Collective reported $1.43M in subscription ARR and said net revenue retention averaged 150%. The portfolio entry gives no measurement window or underlying data.

events.title: Sandbox preview expands to Google Cloud
events.summary: Alien introduced a sandbox preview for Google Cloud deployments, with provider-specific limits on what workloads can access.

events.title: AWS Nitro isolation for EKS sandboxes
events.summary: Alien added support for the AWS Nitro Sandboxes isolation layer on EKS Auto Mode, while keeping its existing SDK interface.

events.title: InstaBox accelerates user-snapshot boots
events.summary: The provider reports new boxes can start in seconds from a matching-size snapshot made from the current agent-browser template.

events.title: Move a running coding session to the cloud
events.summary: Prized can move a Claude Code conversation and project edits from a laptop to a cloud box mid-task. Running local processes are outside the transfer.

events.title: Regional caches speed sandbox startup
events.summary: Vercel reported up to 4× faster startup outside its Washington, D.C. region when image data hits a regional cache.

events.title: Transition support ends
events.summary: Runloop’s wind-down guide set Nov 13 at 11:59 p.m. PT as the end of transition support for existing customers.

events.title: Cloud Agent tasks open to external workflows
events.summary: Railway added asynchronous tasks that can start or resume a cloud agent VM through the CLI, MCP, or API and return results without an open session.

events.title: OpenComputer open-sources its coding agent
events.summary: OpenComputer released its coding-agent implementation and documentation for self-hosting persistent environments.

events.title: Tensorlake founder reports 1.5M+ sandboxes in a day
events.summary: Diptanu Choudhury said Tensorlake ran more than 1.5 million customer sandboxes the previous day. The count is founder-reported and refers to sandbox runs.

events.title: Gemini Managed Agents can run on Sprites
events.summary: Fly documented running Google’s managed agent loop with a Sprite providing its shell, files and network environment.

events.title: Sandbox Events dashboard launches
events.summary: The Events tab now surfaces command execution, TCP tunnel activity, and HTTP requests using Connect Tokens.

events.title: Python SDK breaks down sandbox cost
events.summary: The Python SDK can attribute sandbox spending by tag, date range, and compute type.

events.title: v0.7.15 improves passthrough mounts
events.summary: The project reduced per-file host operations on passthrough mounts and added a way to opt into release candidates.

events.title: machine0 adds remote MCP for cloud VMs
events.summary: The remote MCP server allows connected agent clients to provision, start, suspend and access cloud machines.

events.title: InstaBox adds macOS machines
events.summary: A chooser for cloud macOS machines and Apple chip configurations expands the service beyond Linux and Android.

events.title: AgentCore Runtime v2 becomes the default
events.summary: New endpoints get up to 8 vCPUs, 32 GB RAM, and 10 GB images. AWS reports a sub-two-second P75 start for its 2 GB test image.

events.title: Spheron details agent-driven GPU environments
events.summary: The company documented attaching Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex to a GPU instance for long-running benchmarks, training or fine-tuning.

events.title: Docker template for forkable sandboxes
events.summary: Paid workspaces can launch Docker-enabled sandboxes and fork a paused environment with its containers still running.

events.title: Namespace adds GUI computer use
events.summary: Agents can get screenshots and interact with the Devbox GUI on Linux, macOS and Windows.

events.title: Lambda adds x86 sandbox images
events.summary: AWS added x86 image support in most Lambda MicroVM regions, letting customers run existing x86 software alongside the original Arm option.

events.title: Community reports a 300-trial Tensorlake run
events.summary: A community experiment published by Tensorlake reports 300 passing Harbor rollouts in 100-way batches. Throughput and cost are specific to that workload.

events.title: NVIDIA contributes OpenShell to CNCF
events.summary: NVIDIA announced the runtime’s contribution to CNCF and collaboration with Google to integrate it with Agent Substrate.

events.title: Sandbox logs outlive sessions
events.summary: Depot's SDK can retrieve retained logs after a sandbox stops. Its November changelog says sandbox logs are now kept indefinitely.

events.title: Baseten posts sandbox rates
events.summary: The published rate card introduced separate compute, memory, snapshot, volume and image storage meters. Sandbox promo remained active until November 16.

events.title: Snapshot creation drops below 0.4 seconds
events.summary: Vercel reported median snapshot time fell from 4.4 seconds to under 0.4 seconds; median restore time fell from 500 to 250 milliseconds.

events.title: Tangle publishes sandbox documentation
events.summary: Tangle consolidated sandbox API, SDK, CLI, billing and migration documentation under its documentation site.

events.title: Two community connectors join Sprites
events.summary: Pushover and ZeroGPU joined the connector catalog, extending actions available to agents within a Sprite.

events.title: Native Windows joins Namespace Devboxes
events.summary: Windows machines join the Linux and macOS offerings, with the same Devbox CLI and remote workflow.

events.title: HTTP/1.1 file transfers
events.summary: SDK file upload and download gained an HTTP/1.1 path. E2B also added invitation-only workspace membership.

events.title: Claude Code cloud sessions on Maritime
events.summary: Maritime added support for running Claude Code cloud sessions on its sandboxes, alongside optional residential IPs and flexible Linux desktop sizes.

events.title: Cuttlefish opens iOS preview
events.summary: The Cuttlefish app lets users follow Harness Runtime sessions, steer agents and approve tool calls from an iPhone.

events.title: Baseten launches stateful sandboxes
events.summary: Baseten introduced persistent microVMs with custom or prebuilt images, SDKs, command execution, and public or private previews.

events.title: Base images raise connection limits
events.summary: Version 2 raised bandwidth and connection limits and added live CloudWatch image-build logs.

events.title: Render opens Sandboxes public beta
events.summary: Render announced isolated Linux environments in Oregon with autosuspend, active CPU billing, and support for custom images.

events.title: E2B introduces Workload Identity
events.summary: Sandbox workloads can present a signed identity to a backend without receiving long-lived credentials.

events.title: Persistent workspaces enter preview
events.summary: A persistent workspace can keep files separately from an individual session, so a later session can use the same working files.

events.title: Daytona 2.0 expands to more operating systems
events.summary: Version 2.0 consolidated Linux, Windows, macOS and GPU virtual machines in its composable agent-computer platform.

events.title: On-demand Linux sandboxes launch
events.summary: Maritime added ephemeral and persistent Linux sandboxes billed by the second, plus batch swarms and Windows desktops out of beta.

events.title: Beam merges single-app VM sessions
events.summary: Beam’s open-source runtime merged app-only Linux VM sessions over WebRTC, reusing the disk, snapshot and fork lifecycle. The source is a code merge rather than a hosted availability announcement.

events.title: OpenSandbox 1.2 adds auto-pause and wake
events.summary: The new release includes opt-in auto-pause and wake on access for Fast Sandboxes, a credential vault, and OCI-backed snapshot workflows.

events.title: Akamai introduces Agent Sandbox
events.summary: Akamai announced a tech-preview execution sandbox alongside its managed model inference service.

events.title: OpenSandbox joins the Agentic AI Foundation
events.summary: Alibaba contributed OpenSandbox to the Linux Foundation’s Agentic AI Foundation alongside three other projects.

events.title: MicroVMs reach 14 AWS regions
events.summary: AWS added Hong Kong, Malaysia, Thailand, and Spain as regions for Lambda MicroVMs.

events.title: NVIDIA unveils OpenShell reference architecture
events.summary: The reference design combines sandbox policy with NVIDIA compute and out-of-band monitoring components for enterprise agent deployments.

events.title: Series C takes Blacksmith to $1B valuation
events.summary: Sequoia led the Series C, bringing company-reported total funding to $125M. Blacksmith says it plans to grow its CI cloud compute footprint.

events.title: Depot opens Sandboxes and Managed Agents
events.summary: Depot added isolated Linux microVMs through a Sandbox SDK and connections for agents from Claude, OpenAI, and Devin.

events.title: $60M Series B at $1B
events.summary: FirstMark Growth led Daytona’s Series B. The company stated that the round took cumulative funding to $91M.

events.title: Hosted sandboxes add document tooling
events.summary: OpenAI added the Artifact SDK and tools for spreadsheets, presentations, and Word documents to Agents API hosted sandboxes.

events.title: Scale AI AgentEnv adds Tensorlake
events.summary: Tensorlake became a built-in sandbox provider for the AgentEnv framework’s training and evaluation environments.

events.title: Proton makes its cloud computers public
events.summary: The team shared its internal VM infrastructure with public web, SSH and CLI access. The launch post describes historical hardware and prices.

events.title: $750M Series D at $15.75B
events.summary: Accel led Modal’s reported Series D. Modal announced a separate $300M sandbox product run rate and close to three billion cumulative sandbox starts.

events.title: Browser terminals and scoped S3 access
events.summary: Freestyle shipped expiring browser terminal tokens, more selective outbound rules, scoped S3 access, and longer command runs on updated VMs.

events.title: Region choice expands to SDK create calls
events.summary: SDK callers can specify a region on an individual sandbox or snapshot creation request.

events.title: OpenAI adds sandbox prewarming and active-turn billing
events.summary: Agents API hosted sandboxes can be prepared before attachment. OpenAI also began charging for sandbox compute during active turns only.

events.title: Deno begins transition to Cloudflare
events.summary: Deno announced that its team would join Cloudflare and that Deno Deploy would shut down after six months. Its Sandbox launch page now says new customers cannot sign up.

events.title: Tensorlake documents Cursor cloud-agent execution
events.summary: Cursor can keep the model and agent loop while shell commands, checkouts and builds execute in a Tensorlake sandbox.

events.title: Pine Computer launches
events.summary: Pine AI introduced a persistent computer for agents with browser, shell, filesystem and a shared desktop people can take over.

events.title: Namespace raises $42M Series B
events.summary: Scale Venture Partners led the round. Namespace reports $65 million in total funding after the close.

events.title: Boat debuts full Ubuntu VMs for agent fleets
events.summary: The founder announced the launch of persistent virtual machines with built-in browser, desktop and Docker support.

events.title: Cursor Cloud Agents integration
events.summary: Cursor agents can use configured Superserve machines while retaining sandbox state between turns and pausing compute billing while waiting.

events.title: Active compute rates fall
events.summary: Fly lowered Sprite usage rates to $0.03825/CPU-hour and $0.021875/GB-hour of memory. Retained storage prices stayed fixed.

events.title: Sandbox virtual machines reach GA
events.summary: Modal released full Linux VM sandboxes with support for Docker and FUSE. The gVisor runtime remained the default.

events.title: E2B Embed packages runtime and dashboard
events.summary: Embed packages E2B for one machine so an app can run sandboxes in an end customer’s environment.

events.title: Sandbox SDK 1.0 hands control to Durable Objects
events.summary: A Durable Object can choose the sandbox image and machine size at runtime. Cloudflare announced faster container starts and native container controls.

events.title: OpenShell 0.1 ships open agent controls
events.summary: NVIDIA released the 0.1 runtime with declarative access, gateway and supervision capabilities for operating agent workloads.

events.title: Blaxel adds NVIDIA OpenShell support
events.summary: The company introduced a private preview of its Carbon runtime and announced support for NVIDIA OpenShell in the new generation of Blaxel sandboxes.

events.title: Harnesses and self-serve BYOC microVMs
events.summary: Northflank introduced managed workspaces for coding agents and self-service microVM isolation for customer cloud deployments.

events.title: Docker introduces cloud-hosted sandboxes
events.summary: Docker extended its microVM workflow to managed compute alongside existing local developer-machine support.

events.title: Sapiom reports 2.5M sandbox starts
events.summary: A Blaxel case study reports that Sapiom created 2.5 million sandboxes in its first three months.

events.title: Railway launches Sandboxes on all plans
events.summary: Railway moved its Linux VM sandboxes from Priority Boarding to general availability. The product supports checkpoints, forks, and preinstalled coding agents.

events.title: Sandbox expands to 20 regions
events.summary: Sandbox availability increased from four to 20 Vercel compute regions; paid teams can set failover regions.

events.title: Baseten acquires Blaxel
events.summary: Blaxel announced it had joined Baseten and would continue operating. It announced the Carbon runtime, including sandbox checkpointing and forking.

events.title: Shell and Computer Use sandboxes go GA
events.summary: Google Cloud made Shell and Computer Use sandboxes generally available and added private networking options, customer-managed encryption and pause/resume.

events.title: Sandbox forking becomes stable
events.summary: The fork and snapshot creation APIs graduated from experimental to stable.

events.title: Tensorlake launches BYOC
events.summary: Teams can provision Tensorlake sandbox runtimes inside their own AWS or GCP environment through the managed control plane.

events.title: Devboxes add suspend and resume
events.summary: InstaVM's first published changelog includes persistent Devboxes, suspend/resume and Secrets Vault.

events.title: $800M Series C expands the AI cloud
events.summary: Together AI announced Series C financing to expand its open-model infrastructure. Funding covers the overall platform.

events.title: Baseten raises $1.5B Series F
events.summary: Baseten announced a $1.5B platform-level Series F at a $13B valuation before the standalone sandbox launch.

events.title: AWS introduces Lambda MicroVMs
events.summary: AWS announced a general-purpose Firecracker sandbox service with suspend and resume and control over environment lifecycle.

events.title: One billion sandbox starts
events.summary: E2B reported reaching one billion cumulative sandbox starts. The count measures environments started, with repeat starts included.

events.title: $355M Series C at $4.65B
events.summary: General Catalyst and Redpoint led. Modal said sandboxes drove more than one-third of company revenue at the time.

events.title: Novita announces Agent Sandbox
events.summary: Novita launched an isolated environment for long-running agent systems and code execution.

events.title: Axons add distributed event streams
events.summary: Runloop introduced event streams with structured state and audit trails for clients sharing a remote agent.

events.title: exe.dev announces Series A
events.summary: The company reported $35M in total funding to build cloud VM infrastructure, with Amplify, CRV and Heavybit as major investors.

events.title: OpenAI closes $122B in commitments
events.summary: The company reported a $122 billion round at an $852 billion post-money valuation. Figures apply to the company as a whole.

events.title: Upstash launches Box
events.summary: Upstash introduced cloud computers with persistent files, usage-based CPU metering and an agent SDK.

events.title: $100M Series C extension
events.summary: Georgian led the funding. Render reported $258M in total capital and a $1.5B valuation.

events.title: Koyeb announces Mistral AI acquisition agreement
events.summary: Koyeb said it expected to become part of Mistral Compute and continue its sandbox infrastructure. Closing was subject to conditions at announcement.

events.title: Deno Sandbox enters beta
events.summary: Deno introduced Linux microVMs with host allowlists, guarded credentials, and the ability to turn the same workspace into a Deno Deploy deployment.

events.title: $100M Series B for Railway
events.summary: TQ Ventures led the funding with FPV Ventures, Redpoint, and Unusual Ventures participating.

events.title: exe.dev launches its cloud VMs
events.summary: exe.dev opened developer access to persistent Linux virtual machines controlled through SSH.

events.title: Koyeb Sandboxes enters public preview
events.summary: The preview introduced isolated environments with Docker images, files, command execution and Python or JavaScript SDKs.

events.title: AWS makes AgentCore generally available
events.summary: The service went generally available with an isolated agent runtime and standalone hosted Browser and Code Interpreter tools.

events.title: Riza’s hosted API closes
events.summary: Riza set Oct 1 as its shutdown date. Self-hosted containers with existing offline keys were allowed to keep operating.

events.title: Daytona becomes a migration option
events.summary: Riza announced a Daytona partnership and described credits for its users moving their code-execution workflows.

events.title: Morph previews Liquid Metal
events.summary: Founder Jesse Han previewed newer infrastructure for quickly cloning and restoring compute states at AI Engineer World’s Fair, in a recording published Aug 1.

events.title: $7M seed for Devboxes
events.summary: The General Partnership led the financing, with participation from Blank Ventures.

events.title: $21M Series A
events.summary: Insight Partners led the round, joined by Decibel, Sunflower, Kaya and angels.

events.title: $7.3M seed led by First Round
events.summary: The company announced new funding for its sandbox and agent runtime infrastructure.

events.title: Browserbase raises $40M Series B
events.summary: Notable Capital led the round with CRV and Kleiner Perkins participating. Browserbase simultaneously announced changes to its browser product plans.

events.title: Code Sandbox and Code Interpreter debut
events.summary: Together AI launched a managed VM product for code environments and a separate interpreter API for short executions.

events.title: CodeSandbox SDK exits beta
events.summary: The SDK added higher rate limits and published lower usage rates. The same underlying infrastructure powers Together Code Sandbox. The shared rollout is attributed to Together for territory scoring.

events.title: $2.7M seed and three billion requests
events.summary: Riza announced a Matrix-led seed round and reported processing over three billion execution requests since its developer preview.

events.title: CodeSandbox joins Together AI
events.summary: CodeSandbox announced its acquisition and introduced its SDK for programmatic execution in Firecracker-based sandboxes.

events.title: Azure previews dynamic sessions
events.summary: Microsoft announced prewarmed, isolated Container Apps sessions for AI-generated code and custom workloads at Build 2024.
